name: My Life With 4 Succubus
source:
You know, it’s the usual. One day you think you’re a normal guy with a normal life and stuff, and the next day you find out you’re a genetically designed Demi-Incubus with the duty to have sex with four beautiful and lustful Succubus during 6 months for medical reasons. You know, just the usual.

[from [url=https://www.patreon.com/abrokenaproductions]Patreon[/url]]

你懂的，老掉牙的日常罢了。前一天你还以为自己只是个过着平凡日子的普通人，第二天却突然得知自己是基因工程培育出的半梦魔，而且出于医疗原因，必须在接下来的6个月里履行职责，与四位美艳动人又欲火焚身的魅魔交欢。嗯，你懂的，再寻常不过了。
